verify.note: Measures the CONSEQUENCE, in both directions. The census walks app/ + components/ for every non-test, non-skeleton file that renders <DetailTemplate>, resolves the two wrapper compositions to their callers, and asks each surface whether it resolves its band through lib/layout/detail-hero.ts (its own file, or its server page for a client island) or renders the canonical PageHero in its hero slot. Comment-blind BY LINE, because a block-comment regex is opened by the route glob "/events/*" and swallowed the in-app event page on the first draft. RULED is EMPTY since ADR-1579 (LIVE-447, owner ruling 2026-09-29): the Space profile hero renders <PageHero> itself, and the event poster band is a PosterBand, which COMPOSED maps to its source and counts as on the grammar only while that source renders <PageHero>. Any off-grammar surface fails; the set can only shrink, and it is at zero. A census under 20 surfaces fails as the wrong tree. Two positive controls: the starter Circle page must read as on the grammar, and a copy of it with its resolver call and PageHero tag renamed must read as off.

append.detail: 2026-10-26 (SCAN-1128): two DetailTemplate pages became Frequency bodies, so the census floor drops from 20 to 15. 2026-10-26 (SCAN-1129): the Frequency event cover (FqEventCover) counts as the hero grammar; the DAWN poster band no longer renders on the event page.
